summary: Implemented the engine-free CSV and NIfTI savers and the engine-free plot function, and rewired the three ignite handlers to delegate to them. Changes: new monai/data/csv_saver.py (CSVSaver) and monai/data/nifti_saver.py (NiftiSaver); plot_2d_or_3d_image added to monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py; segmentation_saver.py, classification_saver.py, and tensorboard_handlers.py reduced to thin adapters; write_nifti default dtype changed to np.float32; output_path renamed to output_dir in two segmentation examples and tests/integration_sliding_window.py. Tests added: test_csv_saver.py, test_nifti_saver.py, test_handler_segmentation_saver.py, test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py; test_handler_classification_saver.py updated to pass filename. Not run: tests and flake8 were not executed, per instructions, so they are unverified; static checks for line length (120) and file endings passed. Nothing committed.
